finding: Four-pass warm-start feedback improves typical pressure errors but does not remove the difficult tail. None of the three arms achieves a qualified pass reduction.
interpretation: All four-pass fresh proposals reject at step 16 after 15 native warm-up steps; previous-pressure context is present. No invalid AI state was accepted.

C59 improves 95 of the 128 four-pass snapshots but worsens 33; the largest paired regression is about 3.17x. Aggregate training pressure error and median validation error do not certify worst-case accuracy.

The selected four-pass median residual is 6.77e-6 against the 1e-6 target, and 120/128 snapshots fail it. The gap is not confined to a single outlier; the next objective must improve typical contraction and protect the tail.

The eight-pass candidate passes all snapshots and fresh scenes, but does not improve the worst snapshot residual or worst observed trajectory drift over C53. A longer eight-pass rollout is not the deciding next experiment.
Single seed, 1500-update screening. These results reject promotion of these checkpoints, not the possibility of better future training.
The eight fresh scenes are now consumed evaluation data. Preserve them as regression cases; do not call them untouched in later tuning. Original historical holdouts were not loaded.
One restore HTTP acknowledgement timed out after the Run had committed. Exact request recovery used no remote mutations or retraining; full fresh CPU artifact parity passed.
next_sequence: Before another fit, measure low-mode contraction on small odd and thin rectangular grids using newly generated analytical training cases. Consumed-validation tail examples include 13x15x16, 9x11x11 and 15x9x7; generate new labels/seeds rather than fitting their recorded validation pressures.

Freeze a balanced train-only hard-case bank and compare a tail-aware final-pass physical/low-mode objective against the existing objective, with matched C53 initialization and explicit earlier-pass/eight-pass regression guards. Use a bounded screen before a longer fit.

Require the four-pass snapshot gate and retained eight-pass stability before selecting for independent scenes. Keep current fresh scenes as regression tests and use untouched scenes for the next independent decision.

Separately profile Tuldok restore/readback validation and request-key lookup. Managed workflows took roughly 38-40 minutes for 2.6-5.6-minute trainers; retain authority and hash checks while reducing repeated work.

resources.postfit_diagnostic_scope: A short train-only diagnostic on a fourth distinct CPU core overlapped the simulation pool; no fitting and no GPU work.
